payload.author: claude
payload.body: frick CLI landed + committed ae7867e (in review). crates/frick-cli: the frick binary porting apps/cli to native Rust — JSON-Lines output (+--pretty), exit codes 0/1/2/3, the exact argv grammar, top-level help, cli.unknown_command. Commands schema/lint/migrate/doctor/inspect/reset/tenants/init/scaffold/dev/deploy(plan)/dashboard/mcp call the Rust crates DIRECTLY (frick-codegen for generate, frick-schema for lint, frick-store::migrations for migrate, frick-server push-cred helpers for set-push) instead of shelling to pnpm; run() importable; 42 black-box tests mirror cli.test.ts. frick mcp delegates to the real frick-mcp bridge. Deferred (cli.unsupported, in --help for surface parity): verify (pnpm verify:generated), backup/restore (no dump/restore Rust counterpart), inspect diagnostics (FR-76/77 unported), init --agents (no Rust agent-kit). schema generate writes native artifacts in-process (pnpm→native deviation noted).
